name: AP-15 Navarra (Audenasa) barriers
law: Audenasa's tariffs 2026 (the Gobierno de Navarra's concession of the AP-15): per passage of each barrier, either way, Pesados I (two or three axles) and II (four or more), excluding 21% IVA. Not placed (no named OSM booth), so not priced: Oriz-Tiebas, Marcilla Tronco, Marcilla Enlace.
vehicles: Pesados I and II (trucks over 3.5 t)
